field_stage: Transplant 12-18-month nursery seedlings (5 or more leaves) into 90 cm pits; shade and irrigation start
First dry season: irrigate every 3-5 days, keep shade; count survivors
Year-1 census: count survivors, cull palms under 20 cm girth
Second dry season begins; palms still pre-bearing (bearing starts at 5-8 years)
